title: Saša Jurić - Parsing from first principles - WebCamp Zagreb 2019
summary: Sasa Juric explains how to parse a language from first principles without regexes, live-coding a simple parser combinator library in Elixir. It was given at WebCamp Zagreb 2019.
why: HN commenters recommend it as a clear, dense hour on parsers and parser combinators that holds the audience.

quote.text: Saša Jurić is fantastic at condensing lots of information in a 1 hour talk without losing the audience
